name: Syngene International Ltd

ledger.quote: We expect the full year raw material cost to be around 26%.
ledger.speaker: Deepak Jain
ledger.verdict: Management expected raw material costs around 25% for FY26 and reported year OPM was 25%.

ledger.quote: We expect the effective tax rate for the full year to be around 24%.
ledger.speaker: Deepak Jain
ledger.verdict: The reported results do not provide the effective tax rate range for FY26.

ledger.quote: we expect EBITDA margins to be in the mid-20s for the full year and a degrowth impact due to increased depreciation with the facilities coming online as we have guided in April.
ledger.speaker: Deepak Jain
ledger.verdict: Management guided mid-20s EBITDA margins for FY26 and reported 25% for the year.

ledger.quote: Importantly, the facility is capable of supporting a wide range of advanced conjugates and related modalities and is expected to be operational within this financial year.
ledger.speaker: Peter Bains
ledger.verdict: Management stated expectations to operationalize the ADC facility within this financial year.
ledger.evidence: And we will continue to make investments throughout the year, primarily in operationalizing our Bayview facility...

ledger.quote: And with our Bayview facility for monoclonal antibody manufacturing in the United States, we are on track with our preparations to commence operations in the second half of the year.
ledger.speaker: Peter Bains
ledger.verdict: Management stated expectations to operationalize Bayview in the second half of this fiscal year.
ledger.evidence: By end of this year, we have discussions going on with prospective customers who want to utilize this facility, which will drive revenue growth in FY '28.

ledger.quote: We expect to close the full year with a decline in revenue in the range of 3% to 5% with operating EBITDA margin in the range of 22% to 23%.
ledger.speaker: Deepak Jain
ledger.verdict: Management guided 3 to 5 percent revenue decline and 22 to 23 percent EBITDA margin, reporting 3739 crore revenue and 25% margin.

ledger.quote: Our CAPEX is estimated to be around $45 million by the end of the year.
ledger.speaker: Deepak Jain
ledger.by_when: by the end of the year
ledger.verdict: The reported results do not provide the exact CAPEX figure at the end of the year in dollar terms.

ledger.quote: Given the current geopolitical uncertainties and the near-term impact of Librela, we expect a broadly flat performance for FY27 while maintaining EBITDA margins in the mid-20s through disciplined cost management and sharper operational execution.
ledger.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
ledger.verdict: Management is guiding mid-20s margins for FY27.

ledger.quote: We also expect to start FY27 on a muted note with H2 of FY27 to be meaningfully stronger than H1, with growth weighted towards the second half as new contracts ramp up and business momentum improves.
ledger.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
ledger.verdict: Management expects H2 of FY27 to be stronger than H1.
ledger.evidence: In H2, we have a better visibility on both CDMO as well as our discovery businesses.

ledger.quote: We believe that FY27 will be a year of strategic reset and execution with a healthy pipeline of deal flows that will translate into stronger growth from FY28 onwards.
ledger.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
ledger.verdict: Management expects a higher growth trajectory beyond FY27.

ledger.quote: And as we've outlined, we will continue to have effects through '27, and those are now absorbed in the guidance framework that Kiran outlined. And we would expect to end '27 on a growth trajectory and the Librela effect will then have washed out.
ledger.speaker: Peter Bains
ledger.verdict: Management expects to end FY27 on a growth trajectory.

open.quote: For the full financial year, we do expect a single-digit decline in revenue in rupee terms and EBITDA margins in the mid-20s.
open.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
open.target: single-digit revenue decline and mid-20s EBITDA margin

open.quote: By the end of this fiscal, we expect these actions to position Syngene for a return to profitable and sustainable growth, which will be delivered from FY28 onwards.
open.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
open.target: return to profitable and sustainable growth

open.quote: And this fiscal year itself, you will see a significant ramp-up in utilization.
open.speaker: Siddharth Mittal

read: Management delivers on annual margin and revenue decline guidance ranges when set, but several timelines on facility operationalization remain pending. Future calls will settle the Bayview operationalization and the delivery of stronger second half results for FY27.
questions: Will Bayview operationalize in the second half of this fiscal year as previously guided?
How much of the revenue gap left by Zoetis is covered by new firm orders versus RFP stage discussions?
bull: FY26 revenue decline and OPM targets were met with reported revenue at 3739 crore and 25% margin.
Net cash balance remains high at 1541 crore at the end of Q1 FY27.
Mangalore site utilization is expected to ramp up significantly during this fiscal year.
bear: Q1 FY27 revenue dropped 16% year-on-year to 736 crore due to the absence of Zoetis offtake.
Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 12% impacted by lower revenue and a 50 crore forex hedge loss.
Reported Q1 FY27 PAT was negative 9 crore after exceptional charges.
